operators.name: softplus_forward

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: any shape, same as reference input

semantics: Compute Softplus with beta=1, threshold=20: y = x <= threshold ? log1p(exp(x)) : x (numerically stable formula used by PyTorch)
Input and output have identical shape and strides.

operators.name: avgpool2d_forward

returns.shape: [N, C, floor((H + 2*padding - kernel_size) / stride) + 1, floor((W + 2*padding - kernel_size) / stride) + 1]

semantics: Computes average pooling over 2D spatial dimensions for each (N,C) plane.
Formula: out[n,c,oh,ow] = (1/(kernel_size*kernel_size)) * sum over kh, kw of padded input[n,c,oh*stride+kh-padding, ow*stride+kw-padding] with zero padding.
Padding value 0, no count_include_pad (PyTorch AvgPool2d ignores padding in denominator).
Supports arbitrary N, C, H, W with given kernel_size, stride, padding as ints.
Apply Softplus (beta=1, threshold=20) elementwise to input tensor.
Input shape [512,3,256,256] fp32 CUDA; output same shape and dtype.
Apply AvgPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0) to softplus output.
Input shape [512,3,256,256], output shape [512,3,128,128] fp32 CUDA.
Return the output tensor from AvgPool2d.
Shape [512,3,128,128] fp32 CUDA; identical to step_002 value.
